# Draft:Sharjah Department of Culture

The Department of Culture and Information of the Government of Sharjah is the cultural and media arm of the Emirate of Sharjah. It oversees institutional cultural work by developing and monitoring the implementation of cultural activity programs across the emirate. These activities are distributed among the various departments and sections responsible for their supervision.
Objectives
Among the main objectives of the Department are
*Cooperating with local, Arab, and international cultural institutions and organizations to serve the goals of cultural work.
*Providing activities and programs that reinforce Arab and Islamic values and contribute to fostering a national identity capable of productivity.
*Expanding the horizons of knowledge to support comprehensive development goals — socially, economically, and politically.
*Preserving national culture and arts.
*Defining the priorities of cultural work in accordance with actual needs as part of a long-term strategy.
Structure
The Department is divided into the following sections:
*Planning
*Administrative Affairs
*Theater Management
*Cultural Affairs
*Studies and Publishing
*Information Technology Department
*Media Department
*Public Relations Department
*Eastern Region Management
Awards
The department issues several awards, including:
*Sharjah Award for Arab Culture - UNESCO
*Sharjah Award for Arab Creativity
*Theater Awards
*Sharjah Award for Arabic Poetry
*Sharjah Award for Arabic Poetry Criticism
*Sharjah Award for Critical Artistic Research
*Sharjah Award for Playwriting - Adult Drama Texts
*Sharjah Award for School Playwriting
Festivals
*Sharjah Gulf Theater Festival
*Sharjah Forum for Arab Theater
*Sharjah School Theater Festival
*Sharjah Short Plays Festival
*Sharjah Forum for Theatrical Research
*Sharjah Scout Theater Carnival - Khorfakkan Theater Festival
*Sharjah Forum for Arabic Poetry
*Sharjah Folk Poetry Festival
*Sharjah Theater Days
*Sharjah Calligraphy Forum
*Sharjah Islamic Arts Festival
